mensagens.vigilia: 🌙 Lua's Vigil: just keeping the cache warm. Don't do anything; reply only "ok".
mensagens.estandarte: 🚩 Lua's Banner: write the mission summary now so the work can continue in a new session. Create or update the file NEXT_SESSION.md at the project root, in English, clean and to the point, with: at the top, the text ready to paste into the new session; where everything is (files, folders, commands to run, validate and test); what is done and approved (so it isn't redone); the decisions made and the constraints or gotchas found; the next step in detail, as a numbered plan; and the open tasks and questions. If the project has a CLAUDE.md, add a line to it pointing to NEXT_SESSION.md. When you're done, say in a few lines what was saved.

vigilia.acesa: 🔥 Vigil lit. When the moonlight is about to run out, Lua sends a tiny message to keep the cache warm (up to {max} times, only while you're not typing). Each one spends a bit of your plan limit. Click again to put it out.

ajuda.estado: As Crônicas de Lua: scale {escala}x, {px} px per column, {modo} mode. Level {nivel}, {xp} XP, {paginas}/10 pages.
ajuda.uso: Use /cronicas scale 1|2|3, /cronicas ruler and /cronicas width <px> (calibrate the width), /cronicas image|frame, /cronicas test (compare both), /cronicas new-moon (simulate a cold cache), /cronicas vigil (moonlight near its end, to see the Vigil), /cronicas boss [name] and /cronicas hit (try the boss), /cronicas elite (the next fight is the elite) or /cronicas language (game language).
ajuda.uso_cenario: To see the scenery: /cronicas walk [seconds] (Lua walks, then stops and breathes) and /cronicas stage [biome] (stage change to the next biome or the one you name; no page is counted).
ajuda.uso_atualizacao: New version: /cronicas updates (how to update), updates check (check now), updates off|on (turn the notice off or on).

idioma.como: To change it: /cronicas language <code> (e.g. /cronicas language pt-BR). /cronicas language auto goes back to the system language.

passear.anda: Lua strolls for {s} s, then stops and breathes. The ground loops in about 21 s; the islands, much slower, in almost 2 min. To walk longer: /cronicas walk 120.

atualizacao.em_dia: You have the latest version of The Chronicles of Lua ({local}).
atualizacao.sem_resposta: Couldn't check right now (offline or access blocked). Your installed version is {local}.
atualizacao.bloqueado: Checking is blocked on this computer (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC): the mod doesn't contact GitHub. Your installed version is {local}.
atualizacao.desligado: The new-version notice is off (/cronicas updates on turns it on). Your installed version is {local}.
atualizacao.como: How it works: once a day, in the first session, the mod reads only the version number published on GitHub (a public file). Nothing about you or your conversations is sent, and nothing is downloaded or installed on its own: you decide when to update. /cronicas updates off turns it off; /cronicas updates check checks now.
atualizacao.ligada: New-version notice on: once a day the mod checks whether a new version is out. /cronicas updates off turns it off.
atualizacao.desligada: New-version notice off: the mod no longer contacts GitHub. /cronicas updates on turns it back on.
atualizacao.teste: Test: the Book shows the little star of a pretend new version ({versao}) until the next session. Hover over the Book to see the balloon.
